impl_iters.note: Adapter ServletConnection fallback (DummyServletConnection) already implemented in production code (adapter.jakarta.servlet6.ServletRequest#getServletConnection + adapter.jakarta.servlet61.ServletRequest#getServletConnection). Test wraps the dispatched javax HttpServletRequest with the adapter's jakarta ServletRequest inside a javax HttpServlet (registered via ServletConverter.convert) and probes the four ServletConnection fields (connectionId / protocol / protocolConnectionId / isSecure) over a real Tomcat embed HTTP roundtrip. servlet5 skipped per sidecar action: jakarta 5.0 has no ServletConnection.

dod_check.item: 4 필드 모두 non-null + protocol 형식 정확
dod_check.evidence: 2 modules BUILD SUCCESSFUL, shouldExposeServletConnection() success in servlet6:integrationTest and servlet61:integrationTest. Field-1 connectionId non-null + non-empty (UUID-shaped). Field-2 protocol non-null + matches HTTP/\d+(\.\d+)? (synthesized 'HTTP/1.1'). Field-3 protocolConnectionId non-null (empty string for HTTP/1.1 stream). Field-4 isSecure non-null boolean ('true' or 'false').
